name: versus-v16-death-respawn
description: Keep Versus deaths out of the single-player LoadGame state and respawn each pawn on its own timer after a successful placement.

replacements.old:
reliable if (Role == ROLE_Authority)
        bVersusDead, VersusSlot, SelectedVersusSpell, VersusCastSerial,
        ClientSetVersusSlot;

    reliable if (Role < ROLE_Authority)
replacements.new:
reliable if (Role == ROLE_Authority)
        bVersusDead, VersusSlot, SelectedVersusSpell, VersusCastSerial,
        ClientSetVersusSlot, ClientVersusDeath, ClientVersusRespawn;

    reliable if (Role < ROLE_Authority)
